recent.text: THIS DATE IN #HABS HISTORY Nov. 16, 1977: Ken Dryden recorded his 200th career NHL victory with a 4-1 win over the Rockies in Colorado. Dryden became the 21st NHL goaltender to win 200 games. Yvan Cournoyer, Doug Jarvis, Réjean Houle and Steve Shutt scored for Canadiens. https://t.co/35vq6SnKeQ
recent.author: Stu Cowan

recent.text: THIS DATE IN #HABS HISTORY Nov. 16, 1974: Rookie Mario Tremblay scored his first NHL goal in 4-4 tie with New York Rangers at the Forum. Serge Savard and Jim Roberts also scored for Canadiens and Yvon Lambert had two assists. https://t.co/ClVbrn9mwc
recent.author: Stu Cowan

recent.text: THIS DATE IN #HABS HISTORY Nov. 16, 1971: Yvan Cournoyer recorded his fourth career hat trick, giving him him 200 career NHL goals, and J.C. Tremblay picked up four assists in 7-2 win over the California Golden Seals at the Forum. https://t.co/dDK39YGdZn
